messages:
emily_peopleops: Hi team — quick Q: I just completed an overseas adoption (child is in our custody but final court decree is delayed by ~3 months). Can we add the child to medical/dental now or do we have to wait until the decree? Also curious about payroll deductions retro coverage if we add later. TL;DR: custody now, finalization later.

maria_totalcomp: Congrats 🎉. Good question — this comes up a lot with international adoptions. Short answer: we can provisionally add for benefits if you can provide evidence of legal custody/care and the adoption placement paperwork from the agency/embassy. Final decree needed later to keep it permanent.

emily_peopleops: Awesome — what counts as "evidence of custody"? embassy letter? placement agreement?

maria_totalcomp: Yes — typical accepted docs: placement agreement from the adoption agency, embassy/consulate placement letter, or court temporary custody order. We'll need the final adoption decree within 90 days of the provisional add to avoid reprocessing.

emily_peopleops: Nice. How do I submit docs? DM? email? portal?

maria_totalcomp: Use the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/portal and choose "Add dependent - Adoption (in process)". There's a document upload step. If you hit any issue, tag me or reply here.

emily_peopleops: And payroll? if I add after the child's effective date, do we adjust deductions retroactively?

aj_payroll: Hi — payroll handles retro premiums if the dependent is eligible effective earlier and you provide docs showing coverage effective date. We typically process retro deductions/credits across up to 3 prior pay periods depending on timing and payroll run status. If it's beyond payroll cutoff we do a separate adjustment on the next cycle.

emily_peopleops: Do you need a signed attestation from me that I have custody while final decree is pending?

maria_totalcomp: We ask for a signed adoption placement attestation — the portal has a form. If you prefer, you can upload a scanned agency form plus the attestation. Example required checklist (paste into portal upload):

```
- Placement agreement from adoption agency (PDF)
- Embassy/consulate placement letter or visa docs (if applicable)
- Temporary custody order or court docs (if available)
- Signed Redwood adoption placement attestation form (portal)
- Final adoption decree when available (must be uploaded within 90 days)
```


emily_peopleops: Got it. Are there coverage effective date rules? e.g., is the effective date the placement date or the date we upload docs?

maria_totalcomp: Effective date is generally the placement date (when the child is legally placed in your custody) provided you submit the docs within 60 days of placement. If docs are submitted later, effective date may be the date of submission. That's why upload ASAP.

emily_peopleops: If final decree comes after 90 days what happens?

john_legal: If final decree isn't uploaded within the window, benefits may be terminated retroactively to the placement date and any claims paid could be subject to recovery. We can make exceptions case-by-case — ping legal with a timeline and we'll advise.

emily_peopleops: Thanks — sounds like upload placement docs now and follow up with decree later. One last: do I need SSN/ITIN for the portal upload?

maria_totalcomp: If you have an SSN at time of add, include it. If not (common with international adoptions), you can upload a documented SSN request or ITIN application in the interim. We accept an embassy letter + passport copy while SSN is pending. HR bot will also create a temporary dependent record that you update later.

emily_peopleops: Ok will do today. Thanks all :heart:

hrbot: Reminder: Benefits portal submission received outside business hours may take 1-2 business days to appear in the queue. If you need expedited handling, @maria_totalcomp or @aj_payroll can escalate.

emily_peopleops: One last request — can payroll estimate the retro amount so I can plan?

aj_payroll: Yes — send me the placement date + coverage elections (medical/dental/vision) in DM and I'll run an estimate. If you want, paste here and I'll grab it.

emily_peopleops: Pasting: placement date 2026-02-28, enrolling medical + dental. Thanks!

aj_payroll: Got it, will DM the estimate today.

emily_peopleops: Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
